gn161_diop_presence.note: Astra edition review (revision 1.164): this publisher biography retrospectively compresses the federal-platform titles. OCLC 5736086 gives the cultural/technical/industrial original under [1960]; BnF FRBNF35182688 gives the economic/cultural revised title in 1974. The earlier witness is retained, but it must not identify the later title as the 1960 original. No whole-book reading is added.

rationale: Library edition records are narrower than the retrospective publisher biography used by the earlier packet. The correction changes displayed bibliography/date labels, the existing event label/support and the added anticolonial roster work string; original acceptance records remain frozen and exactly reconstructible. It makes no new argument claim and retains book-unread and named-reader qualifications.
